input.summary: Add numbered Section 7.2A giving the Issuer (as customer) a convenience termination right on 30 days' notice with pro rata refund of prepaid Servicing Fees
input.comment: [Playbook] We have no right to exit this servicing arrangement other than for a Servicer Termination Event, so we add a new Section 7.2A allowing us, as the customer under this Agreement, to terminate for convenience on thirty (30) days' written notice with a pro rata refund of any prepaid Servicing Fees. Section 7.1 already prevents the Servicer from walking away mid-term, so no change is needed there; we can discuss a longer notice period if that is easier.

ops.text: Section 7.2A Termination for Convenience. The Issuer, as the customer under this Agreement, may terminate this Agreement, and the Servicer's rights and obligations under this Agreement, for convenience and without cause, upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to the Servicer, and the Servicer will refund, pro rata, any Servicing Fees paid in advance for any period after the effective date of the termination.
